revenue.source: Inditex FY2024 results PDF (FY2023, FY2024) and FY2025 results PDF (FY2025), net sales, EUR m; FY ends 31 Jan

operating_income.source: Inditex FY2024 & FY2025 results PDFs, EBIT

d_and_a.source: Inditex FY2024 & FY2025 results PDFs, amortisation and depreciation (includes IFRS16 right-of-use depreciation)

capex.source: Inditex FY2023/FY2024/FY2025 results press releases, capital expenditure incl. extraordinary investments

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.2% reported (7.5% FY2024); mgmt targets growth via space and online; fading from ~4.5% toward 4% by FY2030. Analyst judgement, not guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 20.06% (7,997/39,864), FY2024 19.6%; held ~flat at 20% given stable gross margin guidance (+/-50bps).

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. FY2025 effective rate implied by PBT 8,020 vs net profit 6,220 (incl. minorities) ≈ 21-22%; analyst approximation.

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 D&A 3,270 / sales 39,864 = 8.2%; held flat. Includes lease depreciation.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 ordinary capex guide ~EUR2.3bn plus ~0.2bn extraordinary (~6.3% of sales) vs 6.8% in FY2025 with the logistics programme ending; normalise to 6.0%. Note: lease payments not in capex while D&A includes lease depreciation, so FCF is overstated; reviewer should adjust.

wacc.source: Assumption: no debt, euro risk-free ~3%, beta ~0.9-1.0, ERP ~5.5% gives cost of equity ~8%. Analyst estimate.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro inflation ~2%, below nominal GDP.

net_debt.source: Inditex FY2025 results (31 Jan 2026): financial debt 2 - cash 5,276 - current financial investments 5,684 = -10,958 (net cash; matches reported net financial cash 10,958). Excludes leases.

diluted_shares.source: Inditex FY2025 results annex: shares for EPS calculation 3,116,091,486 (millions here). Used as diluted proxy; no material dilution found in search.
